description: This file defines the XSeriesElements class in the PdfSharp.Charting namespace, representing a collection of XValues within a charting context. It provides methods for adding values, cloning the collection, and adding blank entries.

classes.name: XSeriesElements
classes.description: A collection class for managing XValue objects within a chart series, allowing addition of values, cloning, and managing collection contents.

methods.name: XSeriesElements
methods.description: Constructor initializing a new instance of the collection.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the XSeriesElements instance.

methods.name: AddBlank
methods.description: Adds a null (blank) entry to the collection.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds a new XValue to the collection with the specified string value.

methods.name: Add (params string[] values)
methods.description: Adds multiple string values as XValues to the collection.
